lines.text: Over four hundred thousand ancient books vanished from history, but not the way you were told.
By royal decree, every ship docking in Alexandria was searched, and all scrolls were confiscated to be copied.
Popular legend blames a single catastrophic fire set by Julius Caesar in forty-eight BC.
Yet historical records reveal the truth was far more tragic: centuries of civil war, neglect, and budget cuts.
The greatest library on Earth wasn't destroyed in one afternoonâ€”it was slowly starved of care and quietly forgotten.
Human knowledge wasn't conquered by fire, but by indifference. Subscribe to Beyond History for more lost stories.
